name: Vocus MEL04 Mitcham data centre
notes: Vocus-connected data centre list identifies Vocus DC-MEL04 at 28 Thornton Crescent, Mitcham VIC 3132; third-party facility databases describe the Mitcham facility as operational/Tier 3. Mitcham is in the City of Whitehorse.

name: DXC Melbourne Data Center, Burwood East
notes: DataCenterMap lists the facility at 4 Wesley Court, Burwood East; 2019 property reporting describes a three-level data centre of about 10,000 sqm leased to DXC Technology. Burwood East/Tally Ho is in the City of Whitehorse.

name: VMGuest / IPXIDC Box Hill data center
notes: DataCenterMap records a VMGuest/IPXIDC facility at 52-54 Rutland Road, Box Hill VIC 3128, but related listing text indicates the listing may no longer be active; status left unknown. Box Hill is in the City of Whitehorse.

name: Dover SM1A South Morang data centre
developer: Dover DC / PVAC Development Pty Ltd
notes: Victorian ministerial permit PA2402997 covers use/development of land for a data centre at 525 and 535 McDonalds Road and 765 Plenty Road, South Morang, with permit granted 2024-09-12 and amendments approved 2025-06-02 and 2025-10-30. Dover identifies the SM1A project as up to 120MW, with construction expected late 2026/early 2027.

name: Dover SM1B South Morang data centre
notes: Dover's project page identifies SM1B at 165 Williamsons Road, South Morang, directly adjacent to the South Morang terminal station, designed for up to 200MW. Public petition material separately references South Morang data centre concerns and expected construction window for the local developments.

name: Leading Edge DC ABX1 Albury-Wodonga edge data centre
notes: Leading Edge DC lists ABX1 as an Albury, NSW facility with 750kW total site capacity serving Albury and sister city Wodonga; ARN reported the Albury-Wodonga launch and AU$7m investment. Assigned to Wodonga because the named market explicitly spans the border city pair, though the physical facility is on the Albury side.

name: Microsoft Woods Road Truganina datacenter
notes: Microsoft Local says construction began in December 2022 at Woods Road, Truganina. DataCenterMap lists 281 Woods Road, Truganina as part of the Australia Southeast Azure region and expected completion around mid-2025; no public capacity figure found.

name: Hickory Data Centres Truganina hyperscale facility
notes: Local/trade reporting says Hickory broke ground on a Truganina hyperscale facility designed as two 36MW buildings with 18 data halls and availability originally targeted for Q4 2022. Baxtel notes the Hickory 72MW Melbourne project in its Melbourne market timeline; treated as operational based on elapsed build window, but public operator/tenant details remain limited.

name: PGIM Global Data Center Fund Truganina data centre, 1 Oroya Drive
developer: PGIM / The Trust Company (Australia) Limited as trustee of GDCF Truganina Trust
notes: Victorian ministerial permit PA2504032 granted a permit on 2026-05-06 for use and development of land for a data centre at 1 Oroya Drive, Truganina. DataCenterMap describes the site as a AU$1.2bn development on about 20.7 hectares through PGIM's Global Data Center Fund.

name: LMS Energy modular bioenergy-powered data storage facility, Werribee RDF
notes: Star Weekly reported a planning permit application for a $3m modular data centre at the Werribee tip, to be powered by LMS Energy's landfill-gas generation. Wyndham RDF community reference group minutes in 2022 note a visit to the newly established data storage facility adjacent to the LMS gas recovery/energy generation plant.
